title: Reading Beyond OCR Noise: Robust Cross-Lingual RAG for Legislative Archives
title_zh: 超越OCR噪声的阅读：面向立法档案的鲁棒跨语言RAG

paragraphs.en: India’s historical public archives present severe computer vision and document image analysis challenges: decades of parliamentary records survive only as degraded, multi-column scanned pages featuring mixed scripts, complex layouts, and dense visual noise where OCR failure is the primary obstacle to information retrieval. We present an end-to-end framework that couples vision-based layout segmentation and multi-script OCR with an agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline. Our approach specifically addresses how visual degradation and layout fragmentation propagate into text extraction errors, using an iterative agentic loop to navigate around OCR noise and layout ambiguities before generating answers. Evaluated on the 200,000-page Punjab Vidhan Sabha archive, our system demonstrates robust handling of historical document degradation, outperforming standard text-only baselines. The code is publicly available at GitHub Repo .
paragraphs.zh: 印度的历史公共档案为计算机视觉和文档图像分析带来了严峻挑战：数十年的议会记录仅以退化的多栏扫描页面形式保存，其中包含混合文字、复杂版面和密集的视觉噪声，OCR 失效是信息检索的主要障碍。 我们提出了一个端到端框架，将基于视觉的版面分割和多文字 OCR 与智能体检索增强生成（RAG）流水线相结合。 我们的方法专门解决视觉退化和版面破碎如何传播为文本提取错误的问题，利用迭代式智能体循环在生成答案之前绕过 OCR 噪声和版面歧义。 在包含 200,000 页的旁遮普邦立法议会档案上进行评估，我们的系统展现出对历史文档退化的稳健处理能力，优于标准的纯文本基线。 代码已在 GitHub 仓库公开发布。

paragraphs.en: Historical legislative archives are difficult to process because the main challenge is often the document image itself. Faded text, irregular layouts, marginal notes, and mixed scripts can introduce errors during layout analysis and OCR, which then propagate to retrieval and question answering [ 29 , 22 , 23 ] . This is particularly challenging for large archives containing Hindi, Punjabi, and English documents with varying print quality and complex layouts.
paragraphs.zh: 历史立法档案难以处理，因为主要挑战往往在于文档图像本身。 褪色的文字、不规则的版面、页边注释和混合文字会在版面分析和OCR过程中引入错误，这些错误随后会传播到检索和问答环节 [ 29 , 22 , 23 ] 。 对于包含印地语、旁遮普语和英语文档的大型档案而言，由于印刷质量参差不齐且版面复杂，这一点尤其具有挑战性。

paragraphs.en: Rather than treating OCR as a separate preprocessing step, we study the complete pipeline from document images to retrieval and answer generation. Our framework combines layout-aware OCR with an agentic retrieval loop that can check the retrieved evidence, reformulate the query, and search again when the available context is insufficient. This helps keep generated answers grounded in the original document evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不将OCR视为单独的预处理步骤，而是研究从文档图像到检索与答案生成的完整流程。 我们的框架将布局感知的OCR与智能体式检索循环相结合，该循环能够检查检索到的证据、重新表述查询，并在可用上下文不足时再次搜索。 这有助于确保生成的答案始终基于原始文档证据。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) was introduced to combine language models with external knowledge sources [ 14 ] and has since been extended to iterative and agent-based retrieval [ 9 , 25 , 21 ] . Recent document retrieval methods have also moved toward vision-based representations, reducing reliance on OCR for document retrieval [ 8 , 19 ] . Multi-page document understanding further shows the importance of preserving visual information during retrieval and reasoning [ 7 ] . At the same time, OCR benchmarks have shown that multimodal language models still face difficulties with text recognition, particularly for multilingual and visually challenging documents [ 18 ] , while recent work demonstrates that OCR errors can significantly affect downstream question answering [ 22 ] . Language-model-based OCR correction has therefore become an active research direction, especially for historical documents [ 3 , 26 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）的提出是为了将语言模型与外部知识源相结合 [ 14 ]，此后又被扩展到迭代式检索和基于智能体的检索 [ 9 , 25 , 21 ]。 最近的文档检索方法也已转向基于视觉的表示，减少了对 OCR 的依赖 [ 8 , 19 ]。 多页文档理解进一步表明了在检索和推理过程中保留视觉信息的重要性 [ 7 ]。 与此同时，OCR 基准测试表明，多模态语言模型在文本识别方面仍然面临困难，尤其是在多语言和视觉上具有挑战性的文档上 [ 18 ]，而最近的工作表明，OCR 错误会显著影响下游的问答任务 [ 22 ]。 因此，基于语言模型的 OCR 纠正已成为一个活跃的研究方向，尤其是针对历史文档 [ 3 , 26 ]。

paragraphs.en: These developments motivate an end-to-end approach for historical legislative archives in which visual processing, retrieval, and answer generation are evaluated together. We focus on the Punjab Vidhan Sabha proceedings, a large multilingual archive spanning 1950–2024. Our system uses open-weight models throughout the pipeline so that the complete workflow can be deployed locally and the retrieved evidence can be traced back to the source pages.
paragraphs.zh: 这些进展促使我们提出一种面向历史立法档案的端到端方法，将视觉处理、检索与答案生成放在一起进行评估。 我们聚焦于旁遮普邦立法院（Punjab Vidhan Sabha）议事录，这是一个跨越1950至2024年的大型多语言档案。 我们的系统在整个流程中使用开放权重模型，使完整工作流可以在本地部署，并且检索到的证据可以追溯回原始页面。

paragraphs.en: an evaluation of cross-lingual question answering on a large-scale historical document collection;
paragraphs.zh: 对大规模历史文档集合上的跨语言问答的评估；

paragraphs.en: an analysis of how OCR and layout errors affect retrieval and answer quality, together with an ablation of the agentic retrieval loop.
paragraphs.zh: 对 OCR 与版面错误如何影响检索和回答质量的分析，以及对智能体检索循环的消融实验。

paragraphs.en: Work on multilingual archive navigation sits at the intersection of several distinct lines of research: retrieval-augmented generation, agentic search, multilingual text embeddings, and multimodal document retrieval. None of these paradigms were originally optimized for a corpus precisely like ours, making it necessary to examine their contributions and limitations regarding noisy, multi-script legislative archives.
paragraphs.zh: 多语言档案导航的工作位于多个不同研究方向的交汇处：检索增强生成、智能体搜索、多语言文本嵌入以及多模态文档检索。 这些范式最初都不是针对与我们完全类似的语料库而优化的，因此有必要考察它们在处理含噪声、多文字系统的立法档案方面的贡献与局限。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented generation originated from the premise that language models perform better when granted access to external knowledge rather than depending solely on parametric memory [ 14 ] . Gao et al. categorize RAG frameworks into naive, advanced, and modular designs, emphasizing that iterative query reformulation yields greater accuracy gains than merely scaling retriever capacity [ 9 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成源于这样一个前提：语言模型在获得外部知识访问权限时表现更好，而不是仅仅依赖参数化记忆 [ 14 ] 。 Gao 等人将 RAG 框架分为朴素、高级和模块化三类设计，并强调迭代式查询改写比单纯扩展检索器容量能带来更大的准确率提升 [ 9 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Agentic RAG advances this by treating retrieval as an adaptive, multi-step agent loop rather than a static query-response pipeline [ 25 , 21 ] . Architectures that dynamically navigate between keyword indexing, dense semantic search, and document-level browsing offer crucial flexibility for decades-old legislative records [ 1 ] . While agentic orchestration has been successfully demonstrated on historical collections like the CIA’s declassified archives, those implementations typically remained monolingual without addressing script-switching constraints [ 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式 RAG 的进步之处在于，它将检索视为一个自适应的多步智能体循环，而非静态的查询-响应流水线 [ 25 , 21 ] 。 在关键词索引、稠密语义搜索和文档级浏览之间动态切换的架构，为具有数十年历史的立法档案提供了关键的灵活性 [ 1 ] 。 虽然智能体式编排已在中央情报局解密档案等历史藏品上得到成功验证，但这些实现通常仅限单一语言，未涉及文字切换的约束 [ 4 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Cross-lingual and multilingual RAG present distinct structural hurdles. Chirkova et al. demonstrated that maintaining output consistency requires robust prompt design rather than auxiliary translation steps [ 6 ] , while Liu et al. observed performance degradation in cross-lingual retrieval tasks [ 16 ] . Conversely, Li et al. highlighted that incorporating multilingual evidence can stabilize reasoning in ambiguous contexts [ 15 ] . Influenced by these findings, our system indexes Hindi, Punjabi, and English sources concurrently. Foundation models such as Multilingual-E5-Large provide strong cross-lingual mappings, serving as an important precedent for our multi-script workflow [ 28 , 24 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 跨语言与多语言检索增强生成（RAG）面临截然不同的结构性难题。 Chirkova 等人证明，保持输出一致性需要稳健的提示词设计，而非辅助翻译步骤 [ 6 ]；Liu 等人则观察到跨语言检索任务中的性能下降 [ 16 ]。 相反，Li 等人强调，引入多语言证据可以在模糊语境中稳定推理 [ 15 ]。 受这些发现的影响，我们的系统同时对印地语、旁遮普语和英语语料建立索引。 诸如 Multilingual-E5-Large 这样的基础模型提供了强大的跨语言映射能力，为我们的多文字工作流程树立了重要先例 [ 28 , 24 ]。

Romein et al. confirm that structurally complex, multi-script documents remain a primary challenge in AI-assisted archive digitization [ 23 ] .

paragraphs.en: Traditional text-only pipelines often discard critical page layout structures such as tables, headers, and column boundaries, motivating a shift toward multimodal document retrieval. Ma et al. review this paradigm shift toward vision-language document encodings [ 20 ] . Frameworks such as ColPali [ 8 ] , DSE [ 19 ] , and advanced visual embedding architectures like NetraEmbed [ 13 ] encode document images directly into dense vector spaces, preserving layout semantics and layout structures across multiple languages. Cho et al. extended this to multi-page retrieval frameworks [ 7 ] , while Liu et al. emphasize the integration of sparse lexical search with dense visual embeddings as an optimal trajectory for complex document repositories [ 17 ] . Our optimized pipeline leverages these insights by pairing robust multilingual textual dense representations with an adaptive agentic loop tailored for historical legislative document search.
paragraphs.zh: 纯文本的传统流程常常会丢失关键的页面布局结构，例如表格、页眉和分栏边界，这促使研究转向多模态文档检索。 Ma 等人回顾了这一向视觉-语言文档编码的范式转变 [ 20 ]。 ColPali [ 8 ]、DSE [ 19 ] 等框架以及 NetraEmbed [ 13 ] 等先进的视觉嵌入架构，将文档图像直接编码到稠密向量空间中，在多种语言中保留布局语义和布局结构。 Cho 等人将其扩展到多页检索框架 [ 7 ]，而 Liu 等人强调将稀疏词汇搜索与稠密视觉嵌入相结合，作为处理复杂文档库的最优路径 [ 17 ]。 我们优化后的流程利用了这些见解，将稳健的多语言文本稠密表示与为历史立法文档检索量身定制的自适应智能体循环相结合。

paragraphs.en: The dataset used in this research consists of Punjab Vidhan Sabha (legislative assembly of Punjab state) documents collected from archival records spanning from the 1950s to 2024. The collection includes assembly proceedings, debates, reports, notices, and other official legislative documents published across different time periods.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究使用的数据集由旁遮普邦立法院（旁遮普邦的立法议会）档案记录中收集的文献组成，时间跨度从20世纪50年代到2024年。 该文献集合包括不同时期发布的议会会议记录、辩论、报告、通知以及其他官方立法文件。

sents.zh: 该文献集合包括不同时期发布的议会会议记录、辩论、报告、通知以及其他官方立法文件。

paragraphs.en: The records were digitized from bound volumes held by [ https://pvs.neva.gov.in/ ], a process that was carried out incrementally over several decades rather than in a single digitization effort. This matters for the corpus’s characteristics: pages from the 1950s and 1960s were typically typeset on older printing equipment and later scanned at lower resolution, often with visible ink bleed-through, faded typeface, and skewed page boundaries, while more recent decades (post-2020) are comparatively cleaner but still exhibit dense multi-column layouts and inconsistent formatting across sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 这些记录是由 [ https://pvs.neva.gov.in/ ] 保存的合订册数字化而来，这一过程是数十年间逐步进行的，而非一次性的数字化工作。 这对语料库的特征有重要影响：1950年代和1960年代的页面通常是在较旧的印刷设备上排版，后来以较低分辨率扫描，常常伴有明显的墨水透印、褪色的字体和倾斜的页面边界；而较近的年代（2020年后）相对更清晰，但仍呈现出密集的多栏布局以及跨届会议间不一致的格式。

paragraphs.en: Documents in the corpus are predominantly in Hindi (Devanagari) and Punjabi (Gurmukhi), with English appearing throughout, particularly in earlier-era records and administrative headers; it is common for a single page to mix two or all three languages, for instance an English-language question header followed by a Punjabi response, or bilingual tabular data. The collection totals approximately 200,000 pages a covering assembly sessions, starred and unstarred questions, budget and financial statements, committee reports, and procedural notices. Fig. 2 shows representative pages illustrating the multi-column layouts, mixed scripts, and visual degradation typical of the corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 语料库中的文档以印地语（天城文）和旁遮普语（古木基文）为主，同时通篇穿插英语，尤其在早期记录和行政标题中更为常见；单页混合使用两种或全部三种语言的情况很普遍，例如英语的提问标题后接旁遮普语的回答，或者双语的表格数据。 该收藏总量约为200,000页，涵盖议会会议、星号问题与非星号问题、预算与财务报表、委员会报告以及程序性通知。 图2展示了代表性页面，说明了语料库中典型的多栏布局、混合文字以及视觉退化现象。

paragraphs.en: Given the scale of the archive, we did not attempt to hand-annotate the full collection. Instead, we constructed a stratified evaluation benchmark of 1,000 pages and 200 gold-annotated question-answer pairs, sampled to balance representation across decade, script, and document type, so that evaluation results reflect the corpus’s actual heterogeneity rather than only its cleaner, more recent portion. To isolate the contribution of the vision pipeline specifically, we additionally hand-transcribed a smaller subset of 20 pages, selected to span a range of degradation levels, as ground truth for OCR quality evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于档案库的规模，我们未尝试对整个收藏进行人工标注。 作为替代，我们构建了一个包含 1,000 页和 200 对黄金标注问答对的分层评估基准，其抽样方式兼顾了年代、文字体系和文档类型的均衡代表性，从而使评估结果能够反映语料库的真实异质性，而不仅仅反映其中更干净、更晚近的部分。 为了单独衡量视觉流程本身的贡献，我们还人工转录了一个更小的 20 页子集，选取时覆盖了不同程度的退化情况，作为 OCR 质量评估的基准真值。

paragraphs.en: Our primary goal was to evaluate and compare the retrieval performance of various multilingual embedding models and our proposed optimization framework on the domain-specific Punjab Vidhan Sabha (PVS) benchmark.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 1 , token-level and smaller cross-lingual models like MuRIL and LaBSE struggle heavily with the complex, multi-script historical documents, yielding near-zero or low MRR@1 scores. Larger dense retrievers such as Multilingual-E5-Large and NetraEmbed scale better, achieving Hit@3 scores above 0.81. However, BGE-M3 and our optimized pipeline establish the strongest baseline and performance standard, successfully navigating historical OCR degradation and mixed-script text to secure top-tier retrieval accuracy.

paragraphs.en: Despite the strong performance of our multilingual agentic RAG framework, several limitations remain. Severe OCR errors in degraded pages can still affect dense retrieval and entity matching. The iterative agentic loop and LLM-based sufficiency checks also increase inference latency compared with standard retrieval. In addition, complex financial tables and unstructured tabular data may lose hierarchical structure during text-to-chunk conversion. Future work will focus on improving OCR robustness, reducing inference latency, and preserving complex table structures.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管我们的多语言智能体 RAG 框架表现出色，但仍存在若干局限性。 退化页面中严重的 OCR 错误仍会影响稠密检索和实体匹配。 与标准检索相比，迭代式智能体循环和基于大语言模型的充分性检查也会增加推理延迟。 此外，复杂的金融表格和非结构化表格数据在文本转分块过程中可能丢失层级结构。 未来工作将聚焦于提升 OCR 鲁棒性、降低推理延迟以及保留复杂表格结构。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduced an Agentic-RAG framework designed to bridge the gap between complex historical archives and user information needs. By blending iterative query rewriting, adaptive document retrieval, and vision-language generation, our approach effectively tackles the nuances of multilingual document search.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了一个 Agentic-RAG 框架，旨在弥合复杂历史档案与用户信息需求之间的鸿沟。 通过融合迭代式查询重写、自适应文档检索以及视觉-语言生成，我们的方法有效应对了多语言文档检索中的各种细微差异。

paragraphs.en: Evaluated on the Punjab Vidhan Sabha debates dataset—a challenging collection spanning multiple decades in Punjabi, Hindi, and English—the system demonstrated robust resilience against real-world hurdles such as historical vocabulary shifts, degraded text, and severe OCR noise. Unlike traditional, rigid RAG pipelines, the iterative loop implemented here acts as a self-correcting mechanism, dynamically verifying context sufficiency to minimize hallucinations and ground final answers directly in source material.
paragraphs.zh: 在旁遮普邦立法议会辩论数据集——一个跨越数十年、涵盖旁遮普语、印地语和英语的具有挑战性的数据集——上进行评估，该系统在面对历史词汇演变、文本退化和严重OCR噪声等现实世界难题时展现出了强大的鲁棒性。 与传统僵化的RAG流水线不同，这里实现的迭代循环作为一种自我纠错机制，动态验证上下文是否充分，以尽量减少幻觉，并使最终答案直接立足于原始材料。

paragraphs.en: Ultimately, this study highlights that agentic workflows can significantly enhance information discovery in multilingual public records. Beyond historical text exploration, the principles demonstrated here pave the way for more dependable, transparent, and accessible digital archives for researchers, policymakers, and the public.
paragraphs.zh: 最终，本研究强调了智能体工作流可以显著提升多语种公共记录中的信息发现能力。 除了历史文本探索之外，这里展示的原理为研究人员、政策制定者和公众构建更可靠、更透明、更易获取的数字档案铺平了道路。

paragraphs.en: Future work will focus on multi modal retrieval, expanding the system to more Indian languages and government archives, and supporting conversational search with long-context reasoning. User studies with researchers and other archive users will further evaluate its usability and reliability.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作将聚焦于多模态检索，将该系统扩展到更多印度语言和政府档案，并支持具备长上下文推理能力的对话式搜索。 与研究人员及其他档案用户一起开展的用户研究将进一步评估该系统的可用性和可靠性。
